info.name: Koneksi Jasa - Complete API Collection
info.description:
Complete API Collection untuk aplikasi Koneksi Jasa - Platform Jasa Cuci Mobil & Service AC

## Fitur:
- Web Authentication (Login, Register, Logout) - Session-based
- REST API Authentication (Login, Register, Logout, Me, Refresh) - JWT-based
- Dashboard
- Service Providers (User view, Admin CRUD)
- Categories (User view, Admin CRUD)
- Bookings (User create/cancel, Admin manage)
- Role-based access control (User/Admin)

## Base URL:
http://localhost:8000

## Authentication Types:
1. **Web Routes**: Session-based authentication dengan CSRF token
2. **API Routes**: JWT Bearer token authentication

## Notes:
- Default user login: admin@koneksi-jasa.com / password (role: admin)
- UUID digunakan sebagai identifier untuk resource (service-providers, categories)
- Untuk API routes, gunakan token dari response login di header Authorization

## User Roles:
- **user**: Dapat melihat data, membuat booking, melihat booking sendiri
- **admin**: Full access, CRUD service-providers/categories, manage semua bookings

item.name: API - REST Endpoints (JWT Auth)

request.description: Get API information and available endpoints

Register a new user via API.

**Request Body:**
- name: string (required, max 255)
- email: string (required, unique, valid email)
- password: string (required, min 6)
- password_confirmation: string (required, must match password)

**Response:**
- success: boolean
- message: string
- data: { user, token, type, expires_in }

Login user and get JWT token.

**Request Body:**
- email: string (required, valid email)
- password: string (required, min 6)

**Response:**
- success: boolean
- message: string
- data: { user, token, type: 'bearer', expires_in }

**Note:** Token akan otomatis disimpan ke collection variable 'jwt_token'

Get current authenticated user information.

**Headers:**
- Authorization: Bearer {jwt_token}

**Response:**
- success: boolean
- message: string
- data: user object

Refresh JWT token.

**Headers:**
- Authorization: Bearer {jwt_token}

**Response:**
- success: boolean
- message: string
- data: { user, token, type, expires_in }

**Note:** New token akan otomatis disimpan ke collection variable

Logout user and invalidate JWT token.

**Headers:**
- Authorization: Bearer {jwt_token}

**Response:**
- success: boolean
- message: string

query.description: Search by name, description, or address
Sort field: id, name, created_at, updated_at

request.description:
Get list of service providers with pagination and filtering.

**Query Parameters:**
- limit: integer (1-100, default 10)
- page: integer (min 1)
- search: string (search in name, description, address)
- orderBy: string (id, name, created_at, updated_at)
- sortBy: string (asc, desc)
- category_id: integer (filter by category)

**Response:**
- success: boolean
- message: string
- data: { providers, pagination }

Get single service provider by ID.

**Path Parameters:**
- id: Service provider ID

**Response:**
- success: boolean
- message: string
- data: service provider object with category

request.description:
Create new service provider.

**Request Body (form-data):**
- name: string (required, max 100)
- category_id: integer (required, must exist)
- phone: string (optional, max 20)
- address: string (optional)
- description: string (optional)
- photo: file (optional, jpeg/png/jpg/gif, max 2MB)

**Response:**
- success: boolean
- message: string
- data: created service provider object

item.description:
REST API endpoints dengan JWT authentication.

**Base URL:** {{apiUrl}} (http://localhost:8000/api)

**Authentication:**
1. Panggil endpoint Login untuk mendapatkan JWT token
2. Token akan otomatis disimpan ke collection variable 'jwt_token'
3. Gunakan header 'Authorization: Bearer {{jwt_token}}' untuk endpoint yang protected
